questions.q: The Welcome note describes Spirit of Islam as continuing the tradition of which predecessors?
options: These are the two predecessors named in the Welcome note.
The note names two earlier publications.
questions.rationale: Welcome to ‘Spirit of Islam’, a monthly spiritual message, continuing in the tradition of its predecessors, ‘The Spiritual Message’ and ‘Al-Risala English’.

questions.q: According to the Editor’s Desk, what can formal education not teach?
options: Formal education can give you a job, but not the art of living.
The article does not say this.
Professional learning is exactly what formal institutes give.
It says formal education can give you a job.
questions.rationale: Formal education can give you a job, but it cannot teach you the art of living. The art of living can be promoted only through informal education.

questions.q: What does the Persian phrase ‘Sulh-e-Kul’ mean?
options: The phrase is about peace, not victory.
This is not the meaning given.
This is the meaning given, and it is said to express the spirit of Islam.

questions.rationale: A Persian phrase, ‘Sulh-e-Kul’, which means peace with all, truly expresses the spirit of Islam.

questions.q: How does the article define being spiritual?
options: The definition is about orientation towards God.
This is not the definition given.
This is the article’s opening definition.
The article does not define it this way.
questions.rationale: What is spirituality? Being spiritual means to live a God-oriented life.

questions.q: Why does the article say removing religion altogether is no solution to religious conflict?
options: The article does not claim this.
The urge to believe in a greater power is inherent in human nature
Human nature cannot be changed, so removing religion solves nothing.
The article says differences are bound to arise.
questions.rationale: The urge to believe in a greater power is strongly inherent in human nature, and human nature cannot be changed.

questions.q: According to the currently accepted theory cited, how much of the Universe is matter as we know it?
options: The figure given is far smaller.
The article says most of the Universe is unknown to us.
The remaining 96% is thought to be dark matter and dark energy.

questions.rationale: Only 4% of the Universe consists of matter as we know it. The remaining 96% is thought to consist of dark matter and dark energy.
